```{r}

scale_01 <- function(x) {
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

  x_clipped <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)

  scaled <- (x_clipped - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01

  return(scaled)
}

```


## Risk calculation
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstanarm)
library(sf)

# Import combined dataset
tbd_all <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Combine spatial dataset/tbd_all.csv")

tbd_risk <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
Prev_aa_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_aa_scaled) & Prev_aa_scaled > 0,
                     Prev_aa_scaled, NA),
Prev_dv_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_dv_scaled) & Prev_dv_scaled > 0,
                     Prev_dv_scaled, NA),
Prev_is_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_is_scaled) & Prev_is_scaled > 0,
                     Prev_is_scaled, NA),

    # equal weighted additive — 0.5 abundance + 0.5 prevalence
    Risk_aa = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_aa_adj),
                     0.5 * PM_aa_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_aa_adj,
                     PM_aa_scaled),
    Risk_dv = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_dv_adj),
                     0.5 * PM_dv_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_dv_adj,
                     PM_dv_scaled),
    Risk_is = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_is_adj),
                     0.5 * PM_is_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_is_adj,
                     PM_is_scaled),

    Method_aa = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_aa_adj), "Abundance × Prevalence", "Abundance only"),
    Method_dv = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_dv_adj), "Abundance × Prevalence", "Abundance only"),
    Method_is = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_is_adj), "Abundance × Prevalence", "Abundance only")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Risk_aa_scaled = scale_01(Risk_aa),
    Risk_dv_scaled = scale_01(Risk_dv),
    Risk_is_scaled = scale_01(Risk_is)
  )

# Print method summary
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_aa)))
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_dv)))
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_is)))

library(readr)

tbd_risk %>%
  select(County,
         Risk_aa_scaled,
         Risk_dv_scaled,
         Risk_is_scaled) %>%
  write_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv")

cat("Saved: Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv\n")
```

## Deterministic weight sensitivity
```{r}
## DETERMINISTIC WEIGHT SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Weight sequence: 0.00, 0.05, 0.10 ... 1.00
weights <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)

# Number of counties in top 20%
n_top <- ceiling(nrow(tbd_all) * 0.20)   # 21 of 102 counties


## Prepare prevalence exactly as in original risk calculation
sens_data <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_aa_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_aa_scaled) & Prev_aa_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_aa_scaled, NA),
    Prev_dv_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_dv_scaled) & Prev_dv_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_dv_scaled, NA),
    Prev_is_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_is_scaled) & Prev_is_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_is_scaled, NA)
  )


## FUNCTION
run_weight_sensitivity <- function(data, abundance_col, prevalence_col, species) {

  results <- list()
  county_results <- list()

  # Baseline 50:50 score
  baseline_raw <- ifelse(
    !is.na(data[[prevalence_col]]),
    0.5 * data[[abundance_col]] + 0.5 * data[[prevalence_col]],
    data[[abundance_col]]
  )

  baseline_scaled <- scale_01(baseline_raw)

  baseline_rank <- rank(-baseline_scaled, ties.method = "average")

  baseline_top <- data$County[
    order(baseline_scaled, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_top]
  ]


  for (wA in weights) {

    wP <- 1 - wA

    # Same risk calculation, changing ONLY the weights
    risk_raw <- ifelse(
      !is.na(data[[prevalence_col]]),
      wA * data[[abundance_col]] + wP * data[[prevalence_col]],
      data[[abundance_col]]
    )

    # Same scaling as primary analysis
    risk_scaled <- scale_01(risk_raw)

    current_rank <- rank(-risk_scaled, ties.method = "average")

    current_top <- data$County[
      order(risk_scaled, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_top]
    ]

    # Overall rank agreement with 50:50 baseline
    spearman_r <- cor(
      baseline_scaled,
      risk_scaled,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    )

    # Percentage of baseline top-20% counties retained
    retention <- length(intersect(baseline_top, current_top)) /
      length(baseline_top) * 100


    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Species = species,
      Abundance_weight = wA,
      Prevalence_weight = wP,
      Spearman_r = spearman_r,
      Top20_retention = retention
    )

    county_results[[length(county_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      County = data$County,
      Species = species,
      Abundance_weight = wA,
      Prevalence_weight = wP,
      Risk_score = risk_scaled,
      Rank = current_rank,
      Top20 = data$County %in% current_top
    )
  }

  list(
    summary = bind_rows(results),
    county = bind_rows(county_results),
    baseline_top = baseline_top
  )
}


## RUN FOR THREE SPECIES

sens_aa <- run_weight_sensitivity(
  sens_data,
  "PM_aa_scaled",
  "Prev_aa_adj",
  "A. americanum"
)

sens_dv <- run_weight_sensitivity(
  sens_data,
  "PM_dv_scaled",
  "Prev_dv_adj",
  "D. variabilis"
)

sens_is <- run_weight_sensitivity(
  sens_data,
  "PM_is_scaled",
  "Prev_is_adj",
  "I. scapularis"
)


## COMBINE RESULTS

weight_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  sens_aa$summary,
  sens_dv$summary,
  sens_is$summary
)

county_weight_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  sens_aa$county,
  sens_dv$county,
  sens_is$county
)


## PRINT RESULTS

print(weight_sensitivity)


## SUMMARY FOR MODERATE RANGE: 0.40–0.60

moderate_summary <- weight_sensitivity %>%
  filter(Abundance_weight >= 0.40,
         Abundance_weight <= 0.60) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Minimum_Spearman = min(Spearman_r),
    Minimum_Top20_retention = min(Top20_retention),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(moderate_summary)


## SUMMARY FOR BROADER PLAUSIBLE RANGE: 0.20–0.80

broad_summary <- weight_sensitivity %>%
  filter(Abundance_weight >= 0.20,
         Abundance_weight <= 0.80) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    Minimum_Spearman = min(Spearman_r),
    Minimum_Top20_retention = min(Top20_retention),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(broad_summary)


## COUNTIES THAT REMAIN IN TOP 20% AT EVERY WEIGHT FROM 0.20–0.80

stable_counties <- county_weight_sensitivity %>%
  filter(
    Abundance_weight >= 0.20,
    Abundance_weight <= 0.80
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, County) %>%
  summarise(
    Always_top20 = all(Top20),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Always_top20)

print(stable_counties)

cat("\nNumber of stable counties:\n")
print(table(stable_counties$Species))

## TOP-20 MEMBERSHIP HEATMAP

## BASELINE TOP-20 MEMBERSHIP HEATMAP

library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(stringr)

heat_data <- county_weight_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(County=str_to_title(County)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(Baseline_top20=County %in% County[Abundance_weight==.50 & Top20]) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(Baseline_top20)

make_heat <- function(dat,sp,col){
  ord <- dat %>% filter(Species==sp,Abundance_weight==.50) %>% arrange(Rank) %>% pull(County)
  dat %>% filter(Species==sp) %>% mutate(County=factor(County,levels=rev(ord))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(Abundance_weight,County,fill=Top20)) +
    geom_tile(width=.049,height=.96,color="white",linewidth=.12) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=.50,linetype="dashed",linewidth=.6,color="black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("FALSE"="grey94","TRUE"=col),guide="none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-.025,1.025),breaks=seq(0,1,.2),expand=c(0,0)) +
    labs(title=sp,x="Abundance weight",y=NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=.5,face="italic",size=14),
          axis.title.x=element_text(face="bold"),axis.text=element_text(color="black"),
          axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
          plot.margin=margin(3,3,3,3))
}

p_aa <- make_heat(heat_data,"A. americanum","steelblue4")
p_dv <- make_heat(heat_data,"D. variabilis","firebrick")
p_is <- make_heat(heat_data,"I. scapularis","goldenrod")

heatmap_panel <- p_aa+p_dv+p_is+plot_layout(ncol=3)
print(heatmap_panel)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"baseline_top20_weight_heatmap.tiff"),
       heatmap_panel,width=12,height=6,dpi=300,compression="lzw")
```
